APPARITION / ADMIN

Site Operations

Operational controls for new checkout, News and the shared site announcement. Existing orders and fulfilment continue normally. All dates below use UK time (Europe/London).

Configure store state

Customers can browse, add products and edit their saved baskets. Stock and prices are revalidated when checkout resumes; baskets do not reserve stock.

News

Save a draft, publish now or schedule a UK publication time. Effective published posts appear in News even after announcement expiry. Archived posts leave the public site. Saved slugs are stable and cannot be changed.

Posts

New draft

Lowercase words separated by hyphens. Public route: /news/your-slug/

Text with # headings, blank-line paragraphs, - lists, numbered lists, **strong**, *emphasis* and [label](https://address) links. HTML is displayed as text. No images or embeds.

Announcements

One shared bar. An effective store pause always takes priority and cannot be dismissed. Otherwise highest priority wins, followed by most recent publication and stable slug. Future and expired notices are inactive.

Loading…

Public static News and notices refresh through the existing Pages schedule (nominally every five minutes; queueing can delay it). Checkout always checks current database state immediately.

Recent activity

Who changed what and when. Full before/after states are retained privately in the operations audit.

    Commercial destinations

    Enter verified eBay item or shop URLs only. Direct website purchase stays primary when orders are open. Empty configuration adds no external action. Family means the component family; category means its collection route.
